description: ACCDB: DAO Recordset.Seek('=', ...) argument-type matrix on BINARY(16) (IX_BA/IX_BD) and VARBINARY(16) (IX_VA/IX_VD): exact 3-byte SAFEARRAY (41 42 43), 4-byte with trailing zero (41 42 43 00), 16-byte zero-padded SAFEARRAY, empty 0-byte SAFEARRAY, overlength 17-byte SAFEARRAY, BSTR 'ABC', BSTR '', I4(65), UI1(65), Null, Empty, and absent value. Keeps all pages after setup.

args.text: CREATE TABLE TB (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TB PRIMARY KEY, B BINARY(16))
CREATE INDEX IX_BD ON TB (B DESC)
CREATE TABLE TV (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TV PRIMARY KEY, V VARBINARY(16))
CREATE INDEX IX_VD ON TV (V DESC)
